result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count no longer includes cancelled purchase orders. The full offline test suite passes, but I didn't add a test for the cancelled case.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery, which is the same filter the other counts use. Reps with no purchase orders in the period still show 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

I left the javadoc as it was and didn't touch the per-country purchase-order queries, which have the same gap.
